message: Challenge Group D cover for Sabesp: logo lockup + team names over a cyan diagonal panel with an aerial photo of the treatment plant.
layout_trick: Diagonal cyan wedge cuts the full-bleed industry photo, logo lockup and names sit on flat color so text never fights the image.

message: Sabesp at a glance: SP water/sewage monopoly, 375 cities, 28mn people, margins expanding every year.
layout_trick: Three grey-shadow cards on top (ops table, SP map with 375 cities/58% coverage chips, revenue bars with margin line) and a wavy ribbon timeline 1973-2026 below with alternating above/below labels.

message: Brazil's sanitation gap is large, underfunded and legally required to close by 2033.
layout_trick: Twin Brazil choropleths (water vs sewage by state) side by side, then a strip of 3 icon+label regulatory regimes under them, right column pairs capex-per-capita bars with a universalization line chart inside a dashed highlight.

message: BUY: three pillars (binding framework, operational efficiency, capital allocation) shown as orbiting circles around the logo.
layout_trick: Giant logo on the left with concentric arcs and three icon nodes on the arc; huge 'BUY!' in a bracket on the right half - verdict as a hero word.

message: Pillar divider: same orbit graphic with the current pillar bold and the other two faded.
layout_trick: Reuse one master graphic as section divider and fade inactive pillars (opacity) so the reader tracks position in the thesis.

message: Brazil's sanitation was trapped in a broken system: fragmented regulation, no competition, unpredictable tariffs.
layout_trick: Left: 5 icon rows with bold lead-in + short consequence; right: two stacked charts joined by a dashed connector from the bold key phrase to the evidence ('lost decade').

message: The 2020 Legal Framework (regionalization, universalization targets, single regulator) makes sanitation investable and enables cross-subsidies.
layout_trick: Three stacked bordered boxes for framework features next to a Brazil map with URAE bars; bottom-right small table decomposes cross-subsidy case study in R$/m3.

message: Sao Paulo combines Brazil's strongest demand base with an investor-friendly regulator (ARSESP).
layout_trick: Regulator quote paired with a headshot, name and title inside a pale card, next to the bullet clauses - gives expert-interview credibility.

message: ARSESP's low tariff volatility drives higher capital attractiveness (attractiveness gravity score) than peers.
layout_trick: Left: three line charts with sigma labels per regulator; right: bubble chart of states by attractiveness score with the SP bubble enlarged and labeled.

message: Transition slide as full-width cyan band over a ghosted previous slide asking 'who captures Sao Paulo's sanitation opportunity?'.
layout_trick: Fade the prior slide to ~15% and lay a solid cyan band with one rhetorical question - a cheap narrative hinge between sections.

message: Binding milestones, financial guarantees and penalties keep Sabesp accountable across the 36-year concession.
layout_trick: Chevron timeline of 6 dated obligations (2024 to 2060) with headline term in white band; below, capex columns and a 3-box penalties stack.

message: Obligations come bundled with economic rights: revenue, State-funded easements and legal protections offset capex.
layout_trick: Expert-call screenshot with quote in a pale box, and a zoom-cone from a chart bar to a callout box that explains the exact bar.

message: FAUSP fund shields Sabesp's revenue from political tariff suppression: inflows/outflows, BRL 580mn/yr.
layout_trick: Left: 4 icon rows telling a mini causal story (tension, intervention, damage, FAUSP); right: split grey panel 'Outflows' vs 'Inflows' with bars and a dashed connector.

message: A good framework is not enough: Thames Water had the structural advantages and execution destroyed equity.
layout_trick: Foreign analog case: tilted funnel-bars list the structural advantages, then execution-failure line and column charts; the foreign company logo badge top-right marks the case.

message: Pillar divider 2: operational efficiency highlighted on the orbit.
layout_trick: Same orbit master with a different pillar bold per divider.

message: Privatization reset control, incentives and execution: shareholder structure shifts from 50.3% state to dispersed float with Equatorial.
layout_trick: Two treemaps (before/after ownership) show the privatization at a glance; newspaper clipping and governance bullets underneath.

message: Equatorial has 20 years acquiring and turning around distressed utilities (7 concessions since 2004), replicable at Sabesp.
layout_trick: Ribbon timeline of acquisitions with CEO headshots+quotes at both ends, and a heatmap-colored loss-reduction table by concession over years.

message: The turnaround is already visible: personnel/energy costs, opex per m3 and EBITDA margin gap vs peers narrowing.
layout_trick: Cost composition as a tiled bar (width = share), then opex/revenue line, margin lines vs Copasa/Sanepar with dashed highlight over 2024-25.

message: The tariff formula monetizes every efficiency gain below the frozen opex ceiling.
layout_trick: Tariff formula typeset big with dashed boxes under each term and a one-line explanation per term; charts below show opex vs ceiling gap.

message: Old model is a ceiling, new model a value engine: quality gains flow to shareholders and ROIC stays below WACC today.
layout_trick: Progressive reveal series: the same slide in 3 states (old model highlighted, new model highlighted, result chart) via fading the inactive half.

message: Simulated 2027 tariff adjustment shows consistent real adjustment across 35/42 scenarios of Q-factor x U-factor.
layout_trick: Compact cyan-gradient heatmap of tariff adjustment vs Q and U factors beside the formula; blue number cells with darker = higher.

message: Tariff adjustment drove most of the revenue growth while volume barely moved; subsidized-user growth dilutes mix.
layout_trick: Revenue bridge (base 1Q25 to 1Q26 with tariff/volume/mix) plus a breakeven-by-subsidized-users bar chart annotated at 5-6% breakeven.

message: Water losses are geographically concentrated in municipalities with analog meters and obsolete infrastructure.
layout_trick: Two SP municipality maps (loss intensity and digital penetration) with legend boxes inset, plus regression scatter with R2/p-value callout.

message: Sabesp's BRL 3.8bn meter modernization program targets the root cause, unlocking BRL 1.4bn incremental revenue.
layout_trick: Torn-paper newspaper clipping (InfoMoney headline + quote) as external validation sitting next to the incremental-revenue bars.

message: Disciplined capital deployment starts with a funding edge: lowest cost of debt, cheaper mix, privileged DFI funding.
layout_trick: Three-panel peer comparison (cost of debt bars, stacked debt mix by instrument, DFI exposure horizontal bars) with a dashed-border takeaway strip at the bottom.

message: Record capex funded without compromising solvency: leverage vs peers, DSCR and debt headroom of BRL 13bn.
layout_trick: 2x2 mini-charts, each with a 'headline-bold-phrase...' lead-in connecting two panels into a sentence across the slide; dashed highlight box on the 2025-26 forecast.

message: Proven management team with aligned incentives: CEO/CFO/board with Equatorial track record.
layout_trick: Zigzag of 4 headshots with name + prior companies on underlines, next to bars of results delivered and a comp-structure column chart.

message: Capex converts into RAB efficiently under a backward-looking recognition model, backed by long-duration assets.
layout_trick: Before/after dashed boxes comparing regulatory models side by side with an expert-call photo and pull quote on the right.

message: RAB drives capital remuneration as universalization scales; multiples (EV/RAB) tell where upside sits.
layout_trick: Horizontal axis of EV/RAB zones (<1.0x value trap, 1.0-1.5x sweet spot, >1.5x limited upside) read as a verdict scale across Sanepar/Sabesp/Copasa.

message: EMAE deal proves capital allocation unlocks strategic value: bought at a fraction of market price.
layout_trick: Map of the reservoir complex with pins and callouts explaining the strategic logic, then EV/MW bars with Sabesp highlighted in a dashed box.

message: UniversalizaSP extends the RAB playbook: 146 municipalities, adjacent to URAE-1, +BRL 4.6bn revenue.
layout_trick: Left: concentric-circle graphic of program stages; right: neighboring-municipality map and a waterfall that multiplies connections x tariff x consumption into revenue.

message: Risks plotted on an impact x probability matrix grouped in Business, Macro and Sector categories.
layout_trick: Coded bubbles (B1-B3, M1-M2, S1-S2) positioned on the grid with a color-coded legend panel on the right listing what each code means.

message: Closing thesis recap: BUY with three pillars as cards (Regulatory Edge, Operational Efficiency, Capital Deployment) each with 3-4 evidence bullets.
layout_trick: Three tall white rounded cards with Roman-numeral tabs on cyan background, 'BUY!' bracketed on the right.

message: Presentation index lists all slides grouped by pillar with bold pillar headers.
layout_trick: Two-column hyperlinked index grouped by pillar, so a 100-page deck stays navigable.

message: Business model: eight-step water value chain from sourcing to distribution, one step collects payment, with risk beneath each.
layout_trick: Isometric-style illustrated value chain left to right with step name, risk label in cyan underneath; two data charts hang below.

message: Scale turns concessions into monopolies: competition occurs only during bidding, demand never disappears.
layout_trick: Book cover (Competition Demystified) as an image next to a quoted claim and churn-by-sector bars showing sanitation churn is 0%.

message: EV/RAB multiple sweet spot: sensitivity of multiple to EBITDA/Regulatory and CAPEX/QRR.
layout_trick: Table heatmap with color bands (cyan sweet-spot cells, orange off-zone) beside a four-bullet reading guide in a pale box.

message: EMAE: acquisition born from distress, Sabesp the only natural buyer converting a stranded control block into value.
layout_trick: Left vertical stack of 5 transaction steps as blue boxes, right horizontal bars of net cost paid vs obtained by item.

message: Hydrology is a managed risk: reservoirs healthy today, and drought triggers an extraordinary tariff review.
layout_trick: Table with traffic-light status cells (Normal/Good/Excellent) per reservoir feeding a long-run water-level line chart.

message: The 7-system network can redistribute water when one reservoir falls, plus protected forest slows decline.
layout_trick: 3-column infiltration/interception/baseflow pastel icon cards under a bar showing redistribution capacity rise.

message: FMSAI turned a municipal obligation into a regulatory drag: 7.5% of São Paulo gross revenue transferred to the fund.
layout_trick: Vertical dated timeline (2009-2024) beside a 3-period comparison table with risk row 'Prospective risk'.

message: FX exposure is a known risk, fully covered by cross-currency swaps.
layout_trick: Donut of debt currency mix next to a swap flow diagram (Sabesp ⇄ counterparty, pays/receives) and a coverage-100% table.

message: Selic at 14.5 is a known risk: debt stack converted to CDI via swaps, exposure quantified in R$459M pre-tax impact.
layout_trick: Donut for debt composition by index and a conversion table (original index, derivative, result) with a dark call-out box explaining the net effect.

message: Recent infrastructure incidents (water main break, reservoir collapse, gas explosion, gas leak) with photos by date.
layout_trick: 2x2 grid of news photos in cyan frames with date labels - qualitative evidence as images instead of charts.

message: The response: a new safety protocol structured in three pillars (engineering, inspection, certification).
layout_trick: Three-column pillar headers with icons and short action lines, CEO headshot quote and newspaper clipping in column 3.

message: Sabesp P/E NTM has pulled back to lower multiples vs history, offering an entry point.
layout_trick: P/E line over green/yellow/red standard deviation bands (±1σ/±2σ) with the current point circled, next to price chart annotated by events.

message: Path to universalization: targets for 2027-2029 per segment being achieved with remaining gap quantified.
layout_trick: Horizontal progress bars (target vs progress) per year and a vertical remaining-to-target stack with dashed highlight.

message: Management prioritizes growth within São Paulo; the Copasa decision shows capital discipline.
layout_trick: Executive headshot with quote on left and torn newspaper 'Why Sabesp stayed out of Copasa' on right - two proof points side by side.

message: Capital remuneration 2018-2025 rises as investment expands the regulated asset base.
layout_trick: Yellow-highlighted input/output columns in a spreadsheet table above a labeled line chart of total capital remuneration.

message: ROIC DuPont: ROIC, NOPAT margin and invested capital turnover over 2016-2025 with capex outpacing RAB recognition.
layout_trick: Three overlaid lines (ROIC, margin, turnover) with a dashed callout box on 2025 explaining the compression.

message: Operational improvements translate into stronger cash generation: FCFF/FCFE and net income vs OCF.
layout_trick: Left: two-chart stack (cash generation columns with CAGR box above net income vs OCF lines); right: FCFF vs FCFE paired bars across years with highlight on 2025.

message: Projection of regulatory capital remuneration under Bear/Base/Bull scenarios with different capex conversion rates (55/70/85%).
layout_trick: Three scenario columns headed with icons (bear, scale, bull) and darker blue shades from bear to bull; yellow-marked outputs.

message: Universalization follows a steep last-mile curve: cost per connection from R$3.6k to R$10.5k.
layout_trick: Ordered columns by coverage % colored grey to cyan as they cross the milestone, with two dashed callouts for average cost per connection before vs after.

message: WACC Sabesp by year with E/D weights and cost of debt.
layout_trick: Spreadsheet table with the WACC formula in a black box beneath; plain but traceable.
